patch_description: Gen 41's improvement came from seed diversity. I add two new deterministic seed generators: (a) a low-discrepancy golden-ratio seed using fractional parts of k·φ, k·φ² mapped to barycentric coordinates, and (b) a repulsion seed from ~50 vectorized inverse-square repulsion iterations projected via `_clamp_simplex`. These join the existing random seeds in an expanded multistart loop (12 seeds total), which fits comfortably under a second given the current ~0.78s runtime for 5 seeds.
